evidence.notes: Local DML rejects writes and explicit nulls to formula-backed calculated fields with INVALID_FIELD_FOR_INSERT_UPDATE.

source.content: Account a = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); a.put('Score__c', null); Object result = Database.insert(a, false); System.assert(!result.isSuccess()); Object err = result.getErrors().get(0); System.assertEquals('INVALID_FIELD_FOR_INSERT_UPDATE', err.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('Score__c', err.getFields().get(0)); System.assertEquals(0, [SELECT Id FROM Account].size());
